canonical_personas_prompt:
American Caucasian woman with a slim-to-medium build and light complexion. Medium brown slightly wavy collar-length hair with natural texture and soft flyaways at the hairline, hair settled without product. Minimal silver stud earrings, small and close to the ear. Skin with natural bare makeup finish — foundation-matched, soft groomed brows, neutral-warm lip, no gloss, no shimmer. Calm and knowing expression with steady direct eye contact and a trace of quiet conviction. She wears a solid sage green crew-neck top, no logos, no graphics, no patterns.

Mid-gray seamless studio background — even neutral mid-gray, no seam line, no gradient, no falloff to black or white. Relight from scratch overriding any reference lighting: one broad diffused source from camera-left and slightly above, a soft triangle of light on the shadow cheek, gentle wrap onto the face, no hard shadow edges, no rim light, no hair light, no kicker. Skin reads matte and velvety — zero shine on forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, temples, and chin, no oily T-zone — in a low-contrast milky look. Skin renders at its true natural warm skin tone against the neutral gray, warmth preserved and natural, never pale or washed-out or cool-shifted by the background. Real peach fuzz at the jaw and hairline, real soft fine even pore texture, subsurface scattering reading as semi-translucent biology, never plastic, never waxy AI render, never glass-skin, never harsh — fine flattering texture that keeps the face looking good, no acne, no blemishes, no rough pores. Hair rendered strand by strand with realistic flyaways and baby hairs at the hairline. Photographed on a 50mm prime at a wide aperture, natural round bokeh, even sharpness, soft natural film grain. Photographed not generated.

scenes.veo3_prompt_en:
Scene & Mood: A woman leans slightly toward the camera, a knowing sidelong glance and a barely-held conspiratorial half-smile breaking at the corner of her mouth — the look of someone sharing a truth they were never supposed to know.

Frame Map: Subject anchored center-left, x=38%, foreground close-up from collarbone up, face occupying 65% of frame height. The right third holds soft-focus kitchen — a warm window bloom and the edge of white cabinetry as negative space.

Subject Lock: Medium brown slightly wavy collar-length hair, light complexion, solid sage green crew-neck top, minimal silver stud earrings. Body angled very slightly toward camera, head tilted 5 degrees toward screen-right in the conspiratorial lean. Eyes in a knowing sidelong glance tracking slightly left of lens, brows barely lifted, a controlled half-smile held at the corner of the lips, lips closed. Shoulders relaxed, hands off-frame. Face, hair, wardrobe, and silhouette identical throughout.

Cross-Frame Rules: Single subject. No additional figures enter the frame. Subject position, depth, and screen side held throughout.

Movement: The conspiratorial lean holds from frame one — already landed, no settling. Micro-motion only across 5 seconds: a faint chest rise on a quiet breath at second 2, a single baby hair strand catching the kitchen warmth at second 3, the half-smile holding with minimal micro-change. Camera locked off with zero drift. Kitchen background holds still.

Last Frame: Subject in center-left close-up, conspiratorial half-smile and sidelong glance still held, eyes steady and knowing, soft-focus kitchen filling the right third as warm negative space. No on-screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame.

World Plate: Bright American suburban kitchen interior at morning — white upper cabinets with clean hardware, natural wood countertop edge visible far right, soft warm morning light from a window at frame-left, golden-warm color temperature, no visible appliances in the tight framing, quiet domestic warmth.

Sound Bed: Diegetic only — quiet kitchen ambient room tone, faint neighborhood morning ambience at low level, subtle breath on the conspiratorial pause before speaking. Speaking in English: "If you are over 40, eating clean, walking every single day — and the scale still will not budge — it is not your fault. And it is not your metabolism. It is something your doctor probably never told you about."

Capture Realism: Subject sits inside real depth — thin atmosphere suspended in the air between camera, subject, and the soft kitchen background, the background rendered softer, desaturated, and lower-contrast than the foreground so the figure sits within the air rather than pasted on a flat plane. Skin reads true cinematic matte — zero shine on forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, temples, chin, and collarbones, real peach fuzz catching light at the jaw and hairline, real soft fine even pore texture, light absorbed like true subsurface scattering, warmth preserved and natural, slightly desaturated but never pale or washed-out or cool-shifted, never plastic, never doll-skin, never AI-rendered, and never harsh — no acne, no blemishes, no enlarged or rough pores, fine flattering texture that keeps the face looking good. Low-contrast curve — shadows lifted gently holding texture, highlights rolled off softly never clipping to white, nothing crushed to black. All specular highlights surgically removed from skin, hair, fabric, and surrounding surfaces, every pixel reading matte and diffuse. Slightly desaturated grade with warmth preserved.

Camera Capture: wide-latitude cinema capture, vintage 75mm 2x anamorphic character at a wide aperture — oval bokeh, soft frame-edge falloff — light diffusion bloom softening highlights, locked-off static frame, color-negative daylight film rendition with fine 35mm grain, teal-amber grade, shallow depth of field, 24fps 180° shutter, 5 seconds.

production_warnings: Artefato parcial — apenas cena 1 (hook) neste passo. Prompts gerados com Cinema Worldbuilder Pro 2.0 (Veo 3) e Banana Pro Director 2.0 (Nano Banana). Demais cenas a serem adicionadas.
